component.name: Avro Phonetic
component.summary: Bangla phonetic input method for IBus

description.p: Avro Phonetic is a modern Linux implementation of the popular Avro Phonetic Bangla typing method. It works as an IBus input method engine, allowing users to type phonetically in Latin script and have it transliterated on-the-fly to Bengali Unicode text.
Features include rich phonetic transliteration rules, dictionary-based suggestions, suffix inflection handling, customizable preview windows, and an integrated GTK preferences interface.

developer.name: Sarim Khan and Avro Linux Contributors

description.p: Avro Linux release with modernized GTK preferences, privacy hardening, and full regression testing.
